note: Hand-vetted deep-water corridors for the sjokort autorouter. Each LineString follows water known to be navigable; the bake (scripts/bake-sjokort-graph.ts) snaps each vertex to the nearest water, densifies the line into low-cost graph edges, and joins it to the grid. Corridors bridge the narrow, bridge-crossed inner-city channels that a coarse grid cannot resolve (Karlberg -> Riddarfjarden -> Slussen -> Saltsjon -> Lilla Vartan, where the open-sea grid takes over) and bias common runs onto the marked fairway out to Sandhamn. Coordinates are [lon, lat]. These encode local knowledge BY HAND and are NOT depth-checked.
